# /etc/systemd/system/tg-bot-regr.service
[Unit]
Description=Telegram bot for Regression account (modes sleep/monitor/auto)
After=network-online.target
[Service]
User=tbot
Environment=POS_DIR=/opt/trading-bot/positions_regr
Environment=MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl-tg
Environment=TG_ACCT_NAME=M-PM- M-PM-5M-PM-3M-QM-^@M-PM-5M-QM-^AM-QM-^AM-PM-8M-QM-^O
WorkingDirectory=/opt/tg-notify
ExecStart=/opt/tg-notify/venv/bin/python /opt/tg-notify/tg_bot.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
